items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: What molecular description of the free quinoxaline ligand is supported by the supplied crystal structure and an independent molecular investigation, and how should agreement or disagreement with the crystal geometry be interpreted? Establish which structural conclusions are reliable and which remain model dependent.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. Do not equate agreement of several local bonds with a globally correct conformation or phase equilibrium. Finite molecular energies do not establish crystal lattice free energy, solid-state conformer populations, Re-complex behavior or biological activity.
